items.desc: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.

items.name: dsh-model-control
items.desc: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.

items.name: dsh-ccswitch
items.desc: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.

items.name: dsh-plugin-subscriptions
items.desc: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.

items.name: dsh-opencode-bridge
items.desc: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.

items.name: dsh-model-pricing
items.desc: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.

items.name: ark-cli#ark-plan-api
items.desc: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.

items.name: dsh-connect-doubao
items.desc: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.

items.name: agnes-ai-for-dsh
items.desc: Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.

items.name: dsh-llm-hub
items.desc: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.

items.name: dsh-model-router
items.desc: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.

items.name: dsh-opencodego
items.desc: OpenCode Go provider that verifies a model against the gateway rather than treating a recommendation as a measurement: the models.dev protocol suggestion is probed before it is used, reasoning levels follow a measured contract, and requests run through an ordered protocol fallback chain. Context window, max output and image-input numbers are declared by a runtime-refreshed models.dev layer rather than probed, with operator overrides above both. Several OpenCode Go credentials can be stored and switched from the settings page.

items.name: dsh-antigravity
items.desc: Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.

items.name: dsh-commandcode
items.desc: Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel.

items.name: dsh-model-capabilities
items.desc: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

items.name: dsh-chatgpt-web
items.desc: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.

items.name: dsh-model-pro
items.desc: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.

items.name: dsh-connect-qoder-pro
items.desc: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.

items.name: dsh-opencode-models
items.desc: Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.

items.name: dsh-opencode-xdbridge
items.desc: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy-xdpool
items.desc: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, and a model catalog showing per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags).

items.name: dsh-xdpool
items.desc: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.

items.name: dsh-aux-degrade
items.desc: Stops compaction summaries and session titles from burning their output budget on reasoning, by lowering the thinking level and raising the token floor for auxiliary calls only.

items.name: dsh-plugin-freecodego#bundle-latest
items.desc: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-model-list
items.desc: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.

items.name: dsh-model-probe
items.desc: Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.

items.name: dsh-opencode-zen
items.desc: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.

items.name: dsh-freemodels-opencode
items.desc: Connects the OpenCode Zen anonymous free lane to DeepSeek Harness: refresh the model list from upstream, tick which models the opencode provider exposes, test any of them with a real request that ends in one of seven verdicts, and order both the settings card and the model selector by a hand-written S/A/B/C capability rating.

items.name: dsh-advisor-group
items.desc: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.

items.name: dsh-subagent-custom
items.desc: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.

items.name: dsh-openrouter-provider-advisor
items.desc: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.

items.name: dsh-plugin-simple-pet
items.desc: Windows anime companion for DeepSeek balances and Codex quotas, with integrated Codex multi-account OAuth, per-account quota and model management, compact mode and autosaving settings. Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers remain unavailable.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-second
items.desc: Adds an independent OpenCode Go connection with credential settings, manual model discovery, and per-conversation session headers.

items.name: dsh-codex
items.desc: Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.

items.name: dsh-grok-provider
items.desc: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.

items.name: dsh-llm-governor
items.desc: Governs multi-model access, monthly credits, manual/quality/credit/auto routing, failure rerouting, and usage auditing for DSH.

items.name: dsh-opencode-free-models#dsh-opencode-free-models
items.desc: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

items.name: dsh-connect-minimax
items.desc: Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.

items.name: modeltester
items.desc: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.

items.name: dsh-think-ultra
items.desc: Pins every request to the native max-effort tier and adds a per-model/per-mode reasoning-depth panel with a 0-20 capability slider, isolated Velocity/Apex profiles, and offline reasoning toolboxes. Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.

items.name: dsh-plugin-model-capability
items.desc: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.

items.name: dsh-qwen38-local-qol
items.desc: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).

items.name: dmxapi-dsh
items.desc: Configure DMXAPI Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and custom providers; edit models on existing preset routes.

items.name: dsh-codex-switch
items.desc: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: evo-subagent
items.desc: Smart subagent routing and evolution: bind roles to any provider/model registered in DSH, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins, with workspace learning.

items.name: dsh-llm-retry-settings
items.desc: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-web
items.desc: Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.

items.name: dsh-codebuddy
items.desc: Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.

items.name: dsh-claude-driver
items.desc: Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.

items.name: dsh-chatgpt-oauth
items.desc: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.

items.name: dsh-model-sync
items.desc: One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-autostart-workbuddy
items.desc: Starts the WorkBuddy Panel backend (wb2api.exe from workbuddy2api-panel, Windows) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; optionally syncs the backend's /v1/models into the workbuddy provider, and its settings card picks models, shows credit multipliers and installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-opencode2api
items.desc: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.

items.name: dsh-raccoon-connect
items.desc: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.

items.name: dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix
items.desc: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.

items.name: dsh-radeon-cloud-patcher
items.desc: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.

items.name: dsh-zhipu-toolkit
items.desc: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.

items.name: dsh-context-budget
items.desc: Adds per-route context window and compaction threshold fields to the Models settings page and a vendor-aware thinking-effort picker to the composer, writing llm-pi-ai capacities, reasoningEfforts, and a compaction-basic patch row.

items.name: dsh-llm-provider
items.desc: Replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai through a safe-zone download with a one-click enable toggle, and adds provider quota and balance lookups plus a provider management page.

items.name: dsh-provider-switch
items.desc: Enable or disable model providers, search models in the selector, and rename provider display names.
